question: In which year was Volleyball Federation of India established ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Volleyball Federation of India (VFI) is the governing body for volleyball in India.

• VFI was established in the year **1951**.

• It is responsible for organizing national volleyball competitions and managing the Indian national volleyball teams.

• The federation is affiliated with the Fédération Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB) and the Asian Volleyball Confederation (AVC).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Fédération Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB)**

• FIVB is the international governing body for the sport of volleyball.

• It was established in April 1947, and its headquarters are located in Lausanne, Switzerland.

• FIVB organizes the major international volleyball competitions such as the Volleyball World Championships and the FIVB Volleyball World Cup.

• **Asian Volleyball Confederation (AVC)**

• AVC is the continental governing body for volleyball in Asia.

• It was founded in 1952 and is responsible for organizing Asian volleyball competitions.

• AVC is one of the five continental confederations under the FIVB.

• **Indian National Volleyball Teams**

• The Indian national volleyball teams, both men's and women's, represent India in international volleyball competitions.

• These teams participate in tournaments such as the Asian Games, AVC Championships, and the FIVB World Championships.
